x: Ray Middleton walked very well to gain second place only 13secs behind Surrey's Dickie Green. It was his first time over the distance and a fine performance, for three days earlier he had led the Civil Service to victory over the R.A.F. and Met.
In the Stock Exchange 25 miles championships at Hayes, Kent, on April 3rd, Ray Hall (3:52:10) was 2nd to his old rival Dickie Green (3:49:03).

At the half-way mark Middleton was still 4th, nearly 3 minutes behind Nihill, and Ray Hall (14th) was having quite a battle with his old "Brighton" rival Dickie Green, Dave King followed close behind in 18th position, but it was not long afterwards that he suffered disqualification .

Dickie Green (Surrey W.C.), many times winner of the Stock Exchange Brighton, has had Joe as his attendant on 10 occasions. The Wilson brothers both have a great love and respect for Belgrave and the sport of race walking.
